memos.subject: To do this week
memos.body: • With no Buyer, you place every material order yourself.

memos.subject: Cash this month
memos.body: We spent $63,254 more than we took in last month. At that rate the $145,804 in the bank covers about 2 more month(s).

memos.subject: New subdivision
memos.body: A large housing development is handing over keys, and new homeowners are furnishing from scratch. Demand is up this month for: Bookcase, Futon frame, Bunk bed, Toaster, Microwave oven, Floor lamp, Track light kit, Upright vacuum.

memos.subject: Adams Fabrication shuts down
memos.body: Adams Fabrication has gone under after a long run of losses. Its plant at 1382 Hickory Blvd. is up for lease.

memos.subject: Busiest month on the floor
memos.body: The plant turned out 29,749 units last month. We have never made more.

memos.subject: Machine #5 broke down
memos.body: Machine #5 (Die-casting cell) has stopped with a fault. A mechanic is on the way.

memos.subject: Accident on the floor
memos.body: Kevin Phillips was hurt in cell #12 and will be out for several days. Our deductible is $10,600. Guards, fans, mats and a less crowded layout raise a cell's Safety.

memos.subject: Machine #5 broke down
memos.body: Machine #5 (Die-casting cell) has stopped with a fault. A mechanic is on the way.

memos.subject: First order shipped
memos.body: The first truck just left: 100 Desk lamp, invoiced at $949. Expect the money in about two weeks.

memos.subject: Where the openings are
memos.body: Demand runs furthest ahead of supply for: Night light, Flashlight, Sleeping bag. A product made from bought-in parts gets you selling quickly; making your own components later widens the margin.

memos.subject: Getting started
memos.body: The building is bare. From the Catalog, buy a machine and set it down, paint a safety zone on each input square, and hire a Line Worker. Nothing runs until materials arrive, so order those too.

memos.subject: Lease signed: 486 Valley Pkwy.
memos.body: Your lease on 486 Valley Pkwy. in Dayton, OH starts today: 41,800 sq ft at $20,524 a month, due on the first of each month.
